name: Boku no H na Natsuyasumi ~Inaka de Sugosu Hitonatsu no Omoide~
original_name: ボクのHな夏休み～田舎で過ごすひと夏の想い出～
source:
The hot days of summer have arrived... and I have returned to my rural hometown.
Gramps came to pick me up in his car and we head back to his house.

There, there was a girl in a one-piece dress......

Catching bugs, playing tag, flicking skirts, the summer festival,
a girl drying her clothes next to the river...
these sweet and sour summer memories, turn me from a boy, to a man.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE208246.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
炎热的夏天到了……我回到了农村的老家。
爷爷开车来接我，然后我们就回到了他家。

那里，有一个穿着连体裙的女孩……

捉虫子、捉人、甩裙子、夏日祭，
一个女孩在河边晒衣服……
这些酸酸甜甜的夏日回忆，让我从一个男孩，变成了一个男人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE208246.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
